segments.t: for the market is how structurally different
is the memory market now versus historically.
In the past, what you would see
is these very extreme sort of peaks and troughs
of demand cycles where demand would be rising,
supply can keep up, prices would rise,
these companies would do very well,
and eventually supply would catch up
and then you'd see the price fall.
What's happening now is there is unprecedented demand
for memory and the question is,
is how quickly can supply catch up?
Now, I've spoken to a lot of industry execs
the most bullish cases are second half of 2027
where you begin to see that supply catch up.
